plan.text: Take the diamond trick in South if needed, preserving dummy’s diamond spots. The visible sure winners are DA, DK, HA, HK, CA, CK, CQ, and SA. Cash the top clubs while retaining entries, then seek a ninth trick by establishing a long club if the split permits; reassess from the defenders’ discards and follow-up leads. Avoid risking the contract for an overtrick.
